Generated real payloads from /tmp/comp0002/unpacked/COMP0002 (NAVDURGA AUTO, licensed Busy 21) via flowra_busy_agent.BusyDataExtractor v1.5.3 and POSTed them via /api/agent/sync using an HMAC sync_token forged with services.auth_service.generate_sync_token — same production auth vector Busy Agent uses on the wire. 13/13 pytest green. VERIFIED: (a) NEW data_type='payment_vouchers' (VchType=16, 431 real rows, chunked to 50) — HTTP 200/success:true, doc lands in db.payment_vouchers with voucher_id, voucher_date, party_name, party_code, total_amount, ledger_entries, tenant_id, company_id, voucher_type='payment'; (b) NEW data_type='sundry_journals' (VchType=3, all 16 real rows) — landed in db.sundry_journals with voucher_type='sundry_journal'; (c) REGRESSION on the five re-mapped categories all green — purchase_vouchers (VchType=2, 50), contra_vouchers (VchType=19, 50), journal_vouchers (VchType=4, 3), debit_notes (VchType=12, 1), credit_notes (VchType=10+17+18 folded, 50) — every category persists non-zero rows to its Mongo collection; (d) v1.5.2 customer ingest + /api/customers/outstanding round-trip still working — endpoint returns 200 with the enriched projection keys (mobile_number, gst_number, closing_balance surfaced on every returned customer); (e) tenant isolation confirmed — sync_token signed for tenant A rejects an /api/agent/sync claiming tenant B ('Invalid sync token'); missing-token and bad-token both rejected. The iter-113 model-drop bugs on InventoryItem/SalesVoucher are NOT re-exercised here because the new payment_vouchers / sundry_journals handlers write dict-based upserts (not through those Pydantic models) — they're already forward-compatible.

minor.issue: Same multi-FY upsert-key blind spot flagged in iter-113 applies here: filter is {voucher_id, tenant_id, company_id} with no financial_year (routes/sync.py L382, L418). Agent-generated voucher_id now embeds fy ('BUSY-2025-26-204-16') so collisions are avoided in practice, but the backend still has no defence-in-depth. Recommend adding financial_year to the upsert filter for the two new branches (and for the five older branches already flagged).
logger.info at L162 still doesn't log financial_year — hides multi-FY sync mistakes from log tail. Follow-up from iter-113 not yet done.

action_items: None blocking. Optional hardening: add financial_year to the {voucher_id, tenant_id, company_id} upsert filter on the payment_vouchers and sundry_journals branches (defence-in-depth against future voucher_id scheme changes).
Optional: include financial_year in the sync logger.info line (L162) so multi-FY sync ticks are observable in supervisor tails.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/sync.py — the new payment_vouchers (L370-403) and sundry_journals (L405-439) branches follow the correct dict-based upsert pattern (like customers branch), sidestepping the ConfigDict(extra='ignore') model-drop trap that iter-113 flagged on SalesVoucher/InventoryItem. Good pattern; consider migrating the old Pydantic-based branches to this style over time.

extractor v1.5.3 voucher_id scheme is now 'BUSY-{fy}-{vch_code}-{vch_type}' (verified in output: 'BUSY-2025-26-204-16', 'BUSY-2025-26-1088-3'), which resolves the cross-FY collision iter-113 warned about — but the backend upsert filter still doesn't include financial_year, so the moment someone rolls voucher_id back to 'BUSY-{vch_code}-{vch_type}' the collision returns silently. Recommend belt-and-braces.
